title: Magician ability suite
summary: Immediately after advancement, Klein identifies the Magician's core combat and survival toolkit, including Damage Transfer, Flaming Jump, Air Bullets, Paper Figurine Substitute, Flame Controlling and Illusion Creation.

title: A Prepared Magician
summary: Klein demonstrates the Magician combat style in practice, combining preparation with rapid Air Bullet use against Bishop Utravsky.

title: Channels Increase
summary: Alger secures a channel for Deep-sea Naga hair, leaving the Human-skinned Shadow characteristic as Klein's final major Faceless material bottleneck.

title: Battle Encounter
summary: Against Kircheis, Klein uses Spirit Body Threads as an active combat-control tool, achieving initial control while still chaining inherited Magician attacks.

title: Bait
summary: The City of Silver uses Klein's Spirit World Plunderer true soul body as bait, kills the Bizarro Bane/Shapeshifter and secures its blood and forming ingredient for Klein's advancement chain.

title: Bizarro Sorcerer ability suite
summary: After becoming a demigod, Klein measures the qualitative jump in transformation, damage transfer, Flaming Jump, Air Bullets, Spirit Body Thread control, marionette power-sharing and position swapping.

title: Following His True Feelings—Cowardice
summary: After the Dark Demonic Wolf battle, Klein secures the black curtain containing both an Attendant of Mysteries characteristic and a Miracle Invoker characteristic.

title: Following His True Feelings—Cowardice
summary: Klein takes possession of the black curtain whose highest component is the missing Attendant of Mysteries characteristic.

title: Behind the Door
summary: The curtain finishes separating and Klein obtains the standalone Attendant of Mysteries characteristic for his eventual Sequence 1 advancement.

title: Welcome
summary: Klein assembles the Miracle Invoker characteristic, a Worm of Star, a historical projection of Dark Demonic Wolf blood, and a Worm of Time immediately before advancement.

title: Miracle Invoker qualitative change
summary: After advancing, Klein confirms stronger Historical Void use, limited resurrection through past Worms of Spirit, probability influence, historical-scene summoning and the Wishes authority.

title: Authority
summary: Klein identifies The Fool's core Fooling authority and immediately applies its domains in the battle with Amon, including Blind Stupidity and Fooling of time/history.
